title: What Is BookKraft AI and Why We Built It
excerpt: BookKraft AI started as a frustration with ebook publishing. Here's the origin story — what we built, why we built it, and what makes it different from other formatting tools.
meta_title: What Is BookKraft AI? Origin Story and Tool Overview | BookKraft AI
meta_description: BookKraft AI is a suite of ebook formatting tools built to solve the technical problems that block indie authors from publishing. Here's what it is, what it does, and why we built it.
html:
BookKraft AI is a suite of ebook formatting and publishing tools built for indie authors. The short version: we got tired of watching good books fail to publish because of avoidable technical problems.

Here's the longer version of what we built and why.

The Problem We Kept Seeing

Most ebook publishing problems aren't about the writing. They're about the file. Authors finish their manuscripts and then hit a wall of technical requirements: EPUB structure, OPF manifests, table of contents formatting, metadata standards, image size limits, CSS compatibility across devices.

None of this has anything to do with writing a good book. But getting it wrong means KDP rejections, Apple Books rejections, broken formatting on some devices, or a reading experience that undermines the book itself.

The tools that existed to solve this fell into two categories. Expensive paid software (Vellum costs $249.99 and only runs on Mac). Free manual tools (Calibre and Sigil are both excellent but have steep learning curves and require significant time investment). Neither option worked well for someone who writes books and doesn't want a side career in EPUB internals.

BookKraft AI was built to fill the gap between "professional-quality output" and "simple enough to use without a tutorial."

What BookKraft AI Is

BookKraft AI is a collection of sixteen web-based tools that handle specific ebook publishing jobs. They run in your browser. You don't install anything. Your files don't get stored on our servers (for the free tools, processing happens entirely in your browser).

The tools fall into three categories:

Validation and quality checking: The EPUB Validator runs the same structural checks that KDP, Apple Books, and Kobo use — so you catch rejections before they happen. The Word Cleanup Checker scans your manuscript for formatting problems before conversion. The Cover Checker verifies your cover image meets every platform's requirements.

Formatting and conversion: The Full Manuscript Mode converts your .docx or .txt to a valid EPUB 3.0 file in one step. The EPUB Formatter fixes common EPUB formatting errors. The Kindle Format Fixer corrects the encoding and punctuation problems that come from converting Word documents to Kindle format.

Content and metadata: The Metadata Builder generates properly formatted metadata for KDP, Apple Books, IngramSpark, and Draft2Digital simultaneously. The KDP Keyword Finder uses AI to identify the seven search keywords most likely to help readers find your book on Amazon.

The Design Principles Behind It

We made three decisions at the start that shaped everything:

Free tools for the basics. EPUB validation, metadata building, cover checking, word cleanup, and manuscript conversion are all free with no account required. These are the tools every author needs and there's no good reason to put them behind a paywall. We make the free tools genuinely useful, not crippled demos.

One-time pricing, not subscriptions. You don't need to pay monthly to publish a book. The AI-powered tools are available through a one-time Starter or Pro plan. You pay once, you have the tools permanently. No subscription that stops working if you take six months off between books.

No learning curve for the core workflow. Every tool has a clear input and a clear output. Upload your file, run the tool, get your result. The validation report tells you what to fix in plain language, not in EPUB spec jargon. This doesn't mean the tools are simplistic — the validator checks nine categories of EPUB compliance — it means the interface is.

Who It's For

BookKraft AI is built for indie authors who self-publish, for editors and formatters who work with multiple clients, and for authors who are hybrid publishing — working with a publisher but doing some of their own technical work.

It's not built for large publishing houses with in-house production teams, or for developers who need API access to ebook processing. Those use cases exist, but they're not who we optimized for.

What's Next

We're adding tools regularly. The gaps we're working on: better print-to-digital conversion, series metadata management, and deeper accessibility compliance checking for authors publishing in markets that require WCAG compliance.

If you have a specific ebook publishing problem that you think should have a tool but doesn't, the contact page reaches us directly. We built most of the current tools because someone asked.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is BookKraft AI affiliated with any publishing platform?

No. BookKraft AI is independent. We don't have commercial relationships with KDP, Apple Books, Kobo, or any other publishing platform. The tools are designed to help you publish successfully on all of them.

Does BookKraft AI use AI for all its tools?

No. The free tools use in-browser processing without AI — the EPUB Validator, Metadata Builder, Cover Checker, Word Cleanup Checker, and Manuscript Mode are all rule-based tools that run locally in your browser. The AI-powered tools (Kindle Format Fixer, EPUB Formatter, KDP Keyword Finder, and others) use Claude AI for the parts that benefit from language understanding.

Can I use BookKraft AI for languages other than English?

Most tools work with any language. The EPUB Validator, Metadata Builder, Cover Checker, and Manuscript Mode are language-agnostic. The AI-powered tools work best in English currently, with improving quality in other major languages.

Is my manuscript safe when I upload it?

The free tools process files entirely in your browser using JavaScript — nothing is uploaded to our servers. For AI-powered tools, your text is sent to our AI provider for processing but is not stored after the session ends. We publish our full privacy policy at bookkraftai.com/privacy.

How is BookKraft AI different from Vellum or Atticus?

Vellum is Mac-only desktop software focused on print and ebook design. Atticus is cross-platform desktop software with a built-in writing environment. BookKraft AI is web-based, platform-independent, and focused on technical correctness and publishing compliance rather than visual design. The tools solve different problems — many authors use BookKraft AI for validation and metadata alongside Vellum or Atticus for design.
